note: EDR adds a second hard link to every newly created file on the boot volume for ~1–8s then removes it. stat -f %l shows nlink 1→2→1. Inode, size, owner, mode, and content never change.
log: [poll] stat -f %l on any new file in /tmp, $HOME, ~/.claude, a 0700 dir
[hold] inode, size, owner, mode, content never change
[contrast] separately mounted APFS RAM disk or sparse image: nlink stays 1
outputText: nlink-spike; a second hard link on the same inode is not a replaced file
